policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="regRequest" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
        
        
            @("registration " + ((string)context.Variables["regError"] == "" ? "accepted" : "rejected"))
            
        
        
            
                
                    
                    
                        application/json
                    
                    
                        no-store
                    
                    @{
                        var error = (string)context.Variables["regError"];
                        var description = error == "invalid_redirect_uri" ? "Redirect URI is not allowed." : "Client metadata is not allowed.";
                        return new JObject(new JProperty("error", error), new JProperty("error_description", description)).ToString();
                    }
                
            
        
        
            
            
                application/json
            
            
                no-store
            
            @{
                var body = (JObject)context.Variables["regRequest"];
                var response = new JObject(
                    new JProperty("client_id", "{{mcp-shared-public-client-id}}"),
                    new JProperty("client_id_issued_at", DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()),
                    new JProperty("client_name", (string)body["client_name"] ?? "MCP client"),
                    new JProperty("redirect_uris", body["redirect_uris"]),
                    new JProperty("grant_types", body["grant_types"] ?? new JArray("authorization_code", "refresh_token")),
                    new JProperty("response_types", new JArray("code")),
                    new JProperty("token_endpoint_auth_method", "none")
                );
                return response.ToString();
            }

return-response.set-body: {"error":"invalid_client_metadata","error_description":"The registration request could not be processed."}
